compiled_state.title: [dso_reconciler]: differ + create_one inversion duplicates every unmapped Jira issue; bridge_state writes not persisted across passes
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
Live verification pass 1 of epic 3a03 surfaced a P0 architectural defect with two coupled symptoms.

DEFECT A: create_one inversion. The differ emits a 'create' mutation for every unmapped Jira issue. applier.create_one (acli-integration line 269) then calls client.create_issue() which creates a NEW DUPLICATE Jira issue. The intended inbound semantic per epic spec ('Wholly-new Jira issues mirrored down as jira-prefixed local tickets') is NOT what the code does.

DEFECT B: bridge_state persistence. The reconciler writes bridge_state under the main-branch working dir on the GHA runner. The workflow commit step only commits the tickets-tracker dir. bridge_state is THROWN AWAY at job end. Every pass starts with empty prev_snapshot, causing the differ to re-emit create mutations for every Jira issue on every pass.

CONFIRMED EVIDENCE OF DUPLICATION (5 issues so far):
- DIG-4006 labels=['dso-id:DIG-2099'] is a duplicate of DIG-2099 (same summary verified).
- DIG-4007 labels=['dso-id:DIG-2100'] dup of DIG-2100.
- DIG-4008 labels=['dso-id:DIG-2101'] dup of DIG-2101.
- DIG-4009 labels=['dso-id:DIG-2102'] dup of DIG-2102.
- DIG-4010 labels=['dso-id:DIG-2103'] dup of DIG-2103.

These were created during earlier failed passes (before PR 335 unblocked the ACLI label flag bug). Each pass crashed at a different layer (projectKey null, priority dict, label flag) after only ~5 creates landed. THE ONLY REASON THERE ARE NOT 1825 DUPLICATES IS THAT EARLIER PASSES CRASHED EARLY.

Pass 1 (post-PR-335) ran for 9 min with no errors and 1825 enumerated mutations but produced NO new duplicates because client.search_issues finds the existing dso-id labels and short-circuits via the dedup-create-skipped path. Without the prior 5 incomplete duplicates, pass 1 would have created ~1820 new duplicate issues.

BLOCKS: SC1, SC2, SC3, SC4, CC2, CC3a — entire epic closure.

REMEDIATION: this is NOT a tactical bugfix. The differ + applier need to be redesigned to separate inbound (Jira to local mirror) vs outbound (local SYNC to Jira) flows. Combined with the bridge_state persistence defect, the reconciler cannot achieve level-triggered convergence in its current form.

OPERATOR ACTIONS NEEDED:
1. HALT reconciler passes immediately (do not workflow_dispatch reconcile-bridge.yml).
2. Disable scheduled cron: gh workflow disable reconcile-bridge.yml.
3. Delete the 5 duplicate Jira issues (DIG-4006 through DIG-4010) to restore Jira state.
4. Return epic 3a03 to brainstorm with this bug plus 4 prior ACLI bugs as inputs.

Related bugs:
- 4fa9-0846-519e-4c30 ProjectKey null (FIXED)
- 5010-1c6a-9387-4b5b priority dict shape (FIXED)
- c916-74a1-ed06-40e4 add_label --label flag (FIXED)
- 0dee-a535-45dd-4bc4 brainstorm/preplanning research depth (process)
- fe3a-a3fb-4523-4ccc implementation agent ignored old code (process)

comments.body: CLEANUP_DONE 2026-05-24T05:00Z: Deleted DIG-4006 through DIG-4010 (5 confirmed-duplicate Jira issues from earlier failed reconciler passes). JQL labels in (dso-id:DIG-2099, dso-id:DIG-2100, dso-id:DIG-2101, dso-id:DIG-2102, dso-id:DIG-2103) now returns 0 matches. Jira state restored to pre-bug-cluster baseline. Reconcile Bridge cron remains in state=disabled_manually pending architectural rework.
